name: inspira-animated-tooltip
title: Animated Tooltip
blurb: Avatar stack with tooltips that rotate and translate based on cursor position…
description: Renders overlapping circular avatars. On hover, a tooltip appears above with name and designation, rotating and translating proportionally to cursor position within the image area.
use_when: Team galleries or contributor lists that need playful, responsive interactions on desktop.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; relies on precise mouse tracking.
a11y: Images have alt text; tooltips appear on hover only, not keyboard-accessible.

props.name: items
props.type: {id: number, name: string, designation: string, image: string}[]
